def semver_sort(versions):
    def parse_version(v):
        # Split by '+' to separate build metadata
        core, _, _ = v.partition('+')
        
        # Split by '-' to separate pre-release
        if '-' in core:
            base, pre_release = core.split('-', 1)
        else:
            base = core
            pre_release = None
        
        # Parse MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH
        parts = base.split('.')
        major = int(parts[0])
        minor = int(parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 else 0
        patch = int(parts[2]) if len(parts) > 2 else 0
        
        # Parse pre-release identifiers
        pre_identifiers = []
        if pre_release:
            for identifier in pre_release.split('.'):
                if identifier.isdigit():
                    pre_identifiers.append((0, int(identifier)))  # 0 = numeric, sorts first
                else:
                    pre_identifiers.append((1, identifier))  # 1 = string, sorts second
        
        return (major, minor, patch, pre_identifiers)
    
    def sort_key(item):
        version_str, index = item
        major, minor, patch, pre_identifiers = parse_version(version_str)
        # Return tuple for sorting:
        # - major, minor, patch (numeric)
        # - has_prerelease (False for no pre-release, True for pre-release; False sorts first)
        # - pre_identifiers (list of tuples for comparison)
        # - original index (for stable sort with equal precedence)
        has_prerelease = len(pre_identifiers) > 0
        return (major, minor, patch, has_prerelease, pre_identifiers, index)
    
    indexed_versions = [(v, i) for i, v in enumerate(versions)]
    sorted_versions = sorted(indexed_versions, key=sort_key)
    
    return [v for v, _ in sorted_versions]
